summary: Plymouth-born mother of twelve, nine of whom lived, widowed by William R. McAvoy in 1899; kept a restaurant on Main Street and later married the miner John H. Jones; John's 2nd-great-grandmother.
bio:
Catherine A. Murphy was born on 27 April 1860 in Plymouth, Luzerne County, Pennsylvania, though one daughter's marriage record later gave her birthplace as Schuylkill County. In 1870 she was a girl of nine in the Plymouth Township household of Martin and Alice Murphy, Irish-born parents, and in June 1880, aged nineteen and already married to William R. McAvoy, she was back in her father's house with her seven-month-old daughter Mary; her husband was not at home when the census taker called.

She bore twelve children between 1879 and 1899, of whom nine lived: Mary, Agnes, Katherine, William, Josephine, Gertrude, Anna, Elizabeth and Claire. William died in November 1899, two months after the last was born, and in June 1900 the widow, recorded as Katie McAvoy, was keeping a restaurant on Main Street in Plymouth's Fourth Ward with all nine children at home. About 1903 she married John H. Jones, a coal miner some twenty years her junior, and by 1910 the family was at 214 Vine Street, where the grown children worked as nurses, a milliner, a machinist, a telephone operator and a squib maker. She was still there in 1920 and 1930, by then in her seventieth year, with her daughters Mary and Claire. At the marriage of her daughter Elizabeth in 1923 she was recorded as Kathryn Murphy of Plymouth. She died as Catherine Jones at Plymouth on 4 April 1931 and was buried at Larksville. She is John's 2nd-great-grandmother.

conflicts.found: Schuylkill Co., Pa. (daughter Agnes's 1914 marriage docket); "Penna." (daughter Elizabeth's 1923 licence)
conflicts.assessment: The Murphys had a child born in Schuylkill Co. in 1857 and were in Plymouth by 1860 (round 3). A Schuylkill birth for Catherine is possible if the move came in 1860-61. Her 1931 death certificate (#43660) should state her birthplace and parents.

researchNotes:
Catherine A. Murphy was born 27 Apr 1860 in Plymouth and died there 4 Apr 1931; buried Larksville (FS K6NQ-ZX8). Widowed by William R. McAvoy's death in 1899, she married (2) John H. Jones; her daughter Elizabeth lived in his household in 1920. The 1923 licence calls her 'Kathryn Murphy, Plymouth, b. Penna'.

She died as Catherine Jones (her second husband's name): the 1931 index lists CATHERINE JONES, Plymouth, county 40, 4 Apr 1931, file 43660 ([R4-S1]). In 1870 she was "Catherine," 9, in Martin and Alice Murphy's household in Plymouth Township ([R4-S2]). Her daughter Agnes's 1914 marriage docket gives Catharine's birthplace as Schuylkill County ([R4-S3]).
